verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API. Its closest built-in AI capability is an 'agentic mode' toggle in which an LLM plans a search: it extracts filters, splits the request into sub-searches and handles pasted identifiers. That lets users hand off query interpretation to a built-in model, but only within search. The MCP, UCP and agent-payment items serve external agents, not an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose built-in assistant that accepts delegated tasks beyond search planning, any chat or assistant interface inside the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic mode.
